thread:
maria: quick check — where are the final weights for gau-xxl-v2? I'm prepping an onboarding smoke run for 32k context and need the canonical s3 path + config.

alex: s3://redwood-models/gau/gau-xxl-v2/2026-03-10/weights.tar.lz4 (latest sha in the PR). model config is under the same prefix: model.json and tokenizer.json.

maria: perfect, thx. can someone confirm tokenizer quirks? last time we saw emojis split weirdly and blow up seq len.

jon: FYI tokenizer.json has a custom fallback for unicode emojis, but it still produces many small tokens for ZWJ sequences. we've got a patch in the branch that normalizes ZWJ sequences before tokenization.

lisa: @jon which branch? need to include in onboarding run.

jon: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/412 — branch: gau-xxl-token-fix. contains a small pre-tokenize normalize step and unit tests.

maria: thanks. also need to validate max_context setting. model.json currently lists "max_seq_len": 32768 but runtime config expects 65536 if we want 32k user tokens + prefix + replay. which one should we trust?

alex: model.json is conservative. runtime has override via serving_config.yaml -> max_context. for Dedicated we generally set serving_config.max_context = 65536 for this model. but beware KV memory.

maria: on that — can we get a ballpark KV cache footprint per GPU for 32k? need to size instance and batch numbers.

jon: rough numbers: packed-kv-v2 (fp16-ish) ends up ~0.9–1.3 GB per 1k tokens per model shard depending on hidden size & quant. For gau-xxl-v2 we saw ~28–36 GB for 32k tokens on a single shard in fp16. If sharded across 2 GPUs, ~15–18 GB/GPU.

lisa: to be safe assume ~20 GB/GPU for KV at 32k. plus ~8–10GB for activations and model params (quantized). on a p4d instance you'll want >48GB GPU mem or use sharded placement.

maria: ok — i'll target a 2x-shard canary on Dedicated with 48GB GPUs. can someone add config and an autoscaling safety check?

alex: I'll add serving_config updates and a canary rollout plan. i'll also add a mem-based circuit breaker: if OOM_rate > 0.5% in 5m then fallback to gau-xxl-v2-16k variant.

maria: perfect. CI checks? i want a quick validation before we schedule Dedicated runs.

ci-bot: Pipelines triggered: models/validator (commit d4c2a1), infra/config-lint (commit e9a3f0). Validator results: tokenizer sanity ✅, model config parse ✅, KV footprint estimation ran (see artifact).

maria: artifact link?

ci-bot: https://ci.redwood-infra/teams/eng-ml/pipelines/1245/artifacts/kvcache-estimate-1837619876.txt

(devops-bot): small note — serving infra needs a small tweak: our kmem allocator returns slightly different pages for packed-kv-v2; please set env VAR RW_KV_ALIGN=64 for this model to avoid fragmentation.

alex: added RW_KV_ALIGN=64 to canary template in PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-serving/pull/1234 — pls review.

lisa: pinging @alex for code review on the canary template and the memory-circuit-breaker logic. low-risk change but want eyes.

maria: also added a short smoke script to run locally before canary:

```
# run tokenizer & kv footprint check
python infra/tools/validate_model.py \
  --weights s3://redwood-models/gau/gau-xxl-v2/2026-03-10/weights.tar.lz4 \
  --tokenizer s3://redwood-models/gau/gau-xxl-v2/tokenizer.json \
  --max_seq 32768 \
  --kv-format packed-kv-v2
```

maria: this prints tokenization summary + estimated mem. if you see huge token counts for common emojis, run the normalizer branch locally.

jon: note: unit tests for normalizer are in PR; to run them: `pytest tests/tokenizer/test_normalizer.py -q`.

alex: i'll review the PRs today and merge if green. @lisa can you allocate Dedicated canary slots for next Tue 09:00 PT?

lisa: booking now — reserved 2x48GB GPUs in us-west-2 for Tue 09:00 PT. i'll add alerting channel #eng-ml-canaries.

maria: final checklist for me: weights path ✓, tokenizer fix PR ✓, serving_config canary PR ✓, smoke script ✓, canary infra reserved ✓. next: merge and schedule.

jon: one more: add a small prompt set that exercises emoji-heavy and long-reply threads so we catch token blowups. i put a draft under models/qa/prompt_sets/emoji_long.json.

maria: great — thanks team. i'll post results in this thread after the canary run. :rocket:
